definitions.gloss: employee ID card; company ID badge
definitions.explanation: An identification card issued by a company to its employees, used for building access, identity verification, and other workplace purposes.

examples.japanese: {社員証|しゃいんしょう}を{見|み}せてください。
{社員証|しゃいんしょう}がないとビルに{入|はい}れない。
examples.english: You can't enter the building without your employee ID.

examples.japanese: {退職|たいしょく}する{時|とき}に{社員証|しゃいんしょう}を{返却|へんきゃく}しなければならない。
examples.english: You must return your employee ID card when you resign.

notes:
A compound of {社員|しゃいん} (company employee) and {証|しょう} (proof/certificate). In many Japanese companies, the {社員証|しゃいんしょう} doubles as a security access card and is worn on a lanyard around the neck.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {社員証|しゃいんしょう}を{提示|ていじ}する: to present one's employee ID
- {社員証|しゃいんしょう}を{忘|わす}れる: to forget one's employee ID
- {社員証|しゃいんしょう}を{返却|へんきゃく}する: to return one's employee ID
- {社員証|しゃいんしょう}をかざす: to hold up one's employee ID (to a reader)

RELATED WORDS:
- {身分証|みぶんしょう}: identification card (general)
- {学生証|がくせいしょう}: student ID card
- {名札|なふだ}: name tag/badge
